services.name: Fishing Tour
services.desc: Fish in Style on our 22' Godfrey Pontoon Boat! Price includes 2 people. Add up to 6 additional people for $50 per person. About Come fish with Mad Moose Rentals at Quail Creek State Park. Fish in style on our 22' Godfrey SweetWater Pontoon Boat! We supply all rods, reels, tackle, and lures. We also clean and fillet your catch afterward for free. Must have a fishing license! Please Note Captain Damon Atkinson will supply you with all the rods, reels, tackle, and lures, and he’ll also provide snacks and drinks. When the trip’s over, he can also clean and fillet your catch for free. You just Starting at $399 · 3 or 6 Hours · All Ages · Up to 8 People

services.name: 1 Hour - Jet Ski Adventure Rental
services.desc: Quail Creek State Park - Jet Ski Adventure Rental Dive into an adventure on a thrilling Jet Ski ride with Mad Moose. Enjoy our top-of-the-line Jet Skis and tranquil blue water surrounded by scenic vistas of Southern Utah! We are located inside Quail Creek State Park, so no trailer is required! Included Jet Ski Life Jackets Safety Equipment Please Note: There is a mandatory gas charge based on the duration of your rental. A damage deposit is required with EVERY Jet Ski rental ($500 Authorized Damage Deposit). This will be collected upon arrival by credit/debit card only. A mandatory $35 charge Your Adventure, Elevated!
